title: IEEE Xplore Digital Library Adds AI Assistant
summary: IEEE recently released the IEEE Xplore AI Research Suite, built on the full text of millions of peer-reviewed publications in the IEEE Xplore Digital Library. The library offers full-text access to IEEE standards, journals, magazines, conference proceedings, and more. Researchers
reason: Reports a non-model product launch: IEEE released the IEEE Xplore AI Research Suite/AI assistant for its digital library, covered by IEEE Spectrum, a reputable publication. No named AI model or research artifact, so it belongs under the industry rule.
